name: Asia Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Asia Holdings Co., Ltd., along with its subsidiary entities, is primarily engaged in the South Korean market, focusing on the manufacturing and distribution of a wide array of paper and paper-based goods created from pulp and other raw materials. Its offerings in this segment encompass items such as surface board, various liner and kraft boards, linerboard boxes, general paper board, and cardboard. Beyond its paper operations, the company also serves as a significant producer and supplier of essential construction materials. This division's products include cement, ready-mixed concrete, dry mortar, aggregates, and eco-friendly premixed cements. Demonstrating a diversified business model, Asia Holdings extends its services to include investment and financing support for new ventures. Furthermore, it operates an amusement park and is involved in agricultural cultivation, growing a variety of grains and other food crops like rice and beans, specialized crops, and garden trees. The company was established in 1957 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.
